pull.title: feat(commandcode): send the gateway's reasoning_effort and read the reasoning it returns
pull.body:
## What was broken

`commandcode` has **never** sent a reasoning instruction, and could not have surfaced one if it arrived.

Its profile carried `NO_REASONING` (whose `encode()` body is literally `return`), so the outbound body was:

```json
{"model": "minimax/minimax-m3-free", "max_tokens": 32000}
```

No `reasoning`, no `reasoning_effort`, no `thinking`, no `chat_template_kwargs`. Separately, `reasoning_delta_field` defaulted to `"reasoning_content"` while the gateway emits `reasoning` — so even reasoning that *did* arrive was dropped before reaching the client.

Two live databases:

```
WSL db  (228,104 rows, 08-01 -> 08-27)          Windows db (08-27 -> 08-28)
  nous_portal  125702 reqs  93103 thinking (74.1%)   commandcode  6033 reqs  0 thinking
  nvidia_nim    24914 reqs  18869 (75.7%)
  opencode      47480 reqs  12160 (25.6%)
  commandcode   16944 reqs      0 (0.0%)   <--
```

~23,000 requests, zero thinking blocks, across all seven models. Not a regression — a missing feature. Added in #78; `git log v5.60.0..main -- providers/commandcode/` is empty.

## The probe

Command Code's `/v1/models` cannot settle the dialect — every row carries a null `reasoning`, `supported_parameters` and `default_parameters`:

```
claude-sonnet-5          | ctx= 1000000 | reasoning= None | supported_parameters= None
z-ai/glm-5.3-flash       | ctx= 1048576 | reasoning= None | supported_parameters= None
MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3     | ctx= 1000000 | reasoning= None | supported_parameters= None
```

So the dialect was probed live against `api.commandcode.ai`, streaming `POST /chat/completions`, counting reasoning characters in the delta. Raw output:

```
=== z-ai/glm-5.3-flash ===
  bare                        status=200 keys=['content','reasoning','reasoning_details','role'] reasoning_chars=180
  reasoning{enabled:false}    status=200 keys=['content','reasoning','reasoning_details','role'] reasoning_chars=441
  reasoning{exclude:true}     status=200 keys=['content','reasoning','reasoning_details','role'] reasoning_chars=524
  reasoning_effort=none       status=400 err={"error":{"message":"Invalid option: expected one of \"low\"|\"medium\"|\"high\"|\"xhigh\"|\"max\"","type":"invalid_request_error","param":"reasoning_effort"}}
  reasoning_effort=minimal    status=400 err={"error":{"message":"Invalid option: expected one of \"low\"|\"medium\"|\"high\"|\"xhigh\"|\"max\"","type":"invalid_request_error","param":"reasoning_effort"}}
  reasoning{effort:low}       status=200 keys=['content','reasoning','reasoning_details','role'] reasoning_chars=128
  reasoning{effort:high}      status=200 keys=['content','reasoning','reasoning_details','role'] reasoning_chars=500
  reasoning{max_tokens:1024}  status=200 keys=['content','reasoning','reasoning_details','role'] reasoning_chars=514
  reasoning{effort:BOGUS}     status=200 keys=['content','reasoning','reasoning_details','role'] reasoning_chars=489
  reasoning_effort=BOGUS      status=400 err={"error":{"message":"Invalid option: expected one of \"low\"|\"medium\"|\"high\"|\"xhigh\"|\"max\"","type":"invalid_request_error","param":"reasoning_effort"}}
  thinking{type:disabled}     status=200 keys=['content','reasoning','reasoning_details','role'] reasoning_chars=421
  ctk{thinking:false}         status=200 keys=['content','reasoning','reasoning_details','role'] reasoning_chars=561

=== minimax/minimax-m3-free ===
  bare                        status=200 keys=['content','role'] reasoning_chars=0
  reasoning_effort=low        status=200 keys=['content','role'] reasoning_chars=0
  reasoning_effort=medium     status=200 keys=['content','role'] reasoning_chars=0
  reasoning_effort=high       status=200 keys=['content','role'] reasoning_chars=0
  reasoning_effort=xhigh      status=200 keys=['content','role'] reasoning_chars=0
  reasoning_effort=max        status=200 keys=['content','role'] reasoning_chars=0
  reasoning_effort=none       status=400 (same enum error)
  reasoning{effort:BOGUS}     status=200 keys=['content','role'] reasoning_chars=0
```

Two decisive follow-ups.

**Is `reasoning_effort` honoured, or merely validated?** `MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3` (the paid sibling) settles it — it emits nothing by default and kilobytes under `max`:

```
MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3
  bare             rc=0     cc=1265 det=0     rc=0     cc=1196 det=0
  effort=max       rc=8032  cc=1477 det=98    rc=2263  cc=993  det=29
```

**Is the effect monotone?** Three repeats per rung on `z-ai/glm-5.3-flash` (`rc` = reasoning chars, `det` = reasoning_details deltas):

```
bare             rc=2992 cc=1143 det=700   rc=2998 cc=1094 det=715   rc=3342 cc=1108 det=782
effort=low       rc=0    cc=1150 det=0     rc=0    cc=1210 det=0     rc=0    cc=894  det=0
effort=medium    rc=1243 cc=393  det=284   rc=2307 cc=1123 det=538   rc=1762 cc=1068 det=425
effort=high      rc=188  cc=1054 det=45    rc=0    cc=1469 det=0     rc=348  cc=966  det=77
effort=xhigh     rc=4536 cc=1328 det=1055  rc=1639 cc=1057 det=380   rc=1754 cc=1090 det=389
effort=max       rc=2572 cc=937  det=658   rc=2536 cc=1011 det=596   rc=3445 cc=1211 det=821
```

### What the probe establishes

- **`reasoning_effort` is the only reasoning parameter the gateway parses.** An invalid value 400s *and names the enum in the error*; a deliberately invalid `reasoning: {"effort": "bogus_value"}` returns 200 with reasoning unchanged, proving the object is never read. Same for `thinking` and `chat_template_kwargs`.
- **Its vocabulary is `low|medium|high|xhigh|max`.** `none` and `minimal` both 400.
- **It is honoured, not merely accepted** (MiniMax-M3: 0 → 8032).
- **Reasoning arrives as `reasoning` + `reasoning_details` deltas.** Never `reasoning_content`, and no response in any variant put a `<think>` tag in `content`.
- **`minimax/minimax-m3-free` — the dominant model in the request log — has no reasoning channel at all** under any dialect. Its 0% is a property of that model, not of this bug. The rest of the catalogue is not.

## What this does

Wires `NamedEffortReasoning` over the probed enum — no new encoder needed, and nothing branches on a model name:

| Decision | Value | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Encoder | `NamedEffortReasoning(_EFFORTS)` | top-level `reasoning_effort` string is the only parsed knob |
| Vocabulary | `MINIMAL→low, LOW→low, MEDIUM→medium, HIGH→high, XHIGH→xhigh, MAX→max` | the gateway's own rejection message; `minimal` 400s so it folds onto `low` |
| `disabled_value` | **none** | the enum has no off rung; `none`/`minimal` both 400, so OFF sends no reasoning field — the dialect's only correct disabled shape |
| `enabled_value` | **none** | a bare request already reasons the most on offer (rc≈3000 vs rc≈180 at `high`); naming a rung for "on, effort unspecified" would *reduce* reasoning |
| `use_extra_body` | `False` | `reasoning_effort` is a first-class SDK param and the gateway reads it top-level |
| `reasoning_delta_field` | `"reasoning"` (fallback `"reasoning_content"`) | what the gateway actually emits |
| `reasoning_replay` | `REASONING`, was `THINK_TAGS` | no probe response ever produced a `<think>` tag; history was re-encoded in a shape this gateway never emits |
| `include_extra_body` | `True` + `validate_extra_body_does_not_override_canonical_fields` | matches `openrouter_gateway`/`zenmux`; caller extras reach the gateway but cannot forge `reasoning_effort` |

**Anthropic-protocol half: no change needed.** `claude-*` models route to `AnthropicMessagesProvider`, which goes through `build_anthropic_messages_body`; its `_apply_reasoning` already emits the native `thinking` object (`adaptive`, or `enabled` with `budget_tokens`) and pops it on OFF. Only the OpenAI half was blind. Verified by reading `providers/anthropic_messages/request.py`, not assumed.

## Tests

Ten new tests in `tests/providers/test_commandcode.py`:

- outbound body for `minimax/minimax-m3-free` at effort=max carries `reasoning_effort: "max"` and *none* of the silently-discarded shapes;
- every `ReasoningEffort` encodes inside the published enum (parametrized);
- an effort clamped to the model's vocabulary (`['high','low','medium']`, tier 8 of 5.68.1's ladder) still encodes;
- OFF emits no reasoning field;
- ON with no effort keeps the gateway default;
- caller `extra_body` passes through, and a forged `reasoning_effort` raises `InvalidRequestError`;
- `reasoning_delta()` reads the `reasoning` field, and assistant history replays as `reasoning` with no `reasoning_content` and no `<think>`;
- regression guard: `bedrock`/`cline` still send no reasoning at all, while `ollama` keeps `reasoning_effort: "max"` and `zenmux` keeps `extra_body.reasoning = {"effort": "xhigh"}` — so a future edit to the shared encoders can neither spread this change nor erase a neighbour's dialect.

## Verification

`.\scripts\ci.ps1` — suppression grep, `ruff format`, `ruff check --fix`, `ty check` all clean.

```
14 failed, 5661 passed, 38 skipped in 97.21s (0:01:37)
```

Exactly the pre-existing baseline: 6 PowerShell installer tests and 8 websearch tests that read the real `~/.fcc/.env`. None in the touched files. `tests/providers/test_commandcode.py`: 24 passed.

Version bumped 5.68.1 → **5.69.0** (MINOR — a provider gains reasoning) with `uv lock` in the same commit.

## Residual risks

- **`high` measures lower than `medium` on `glm-5.3-flash`** (rc≈180 vs rc≈1700). The mapping is faithful to the vendor's published enum rather than to that measurement; re-ordering the rungs to fit three samples would be over-fitting to one model on one day, and would be exactly the model-name branching the architecture forbids. SUSPECTED gateway-side routing variance across upstreams, not a mapping error.
- **`reasoning_details` are received but not replayed.** The gateway emits them (OpenRouter family), and `zenmux`/`cline`/`openrouter_gateway` handle them via `apply_reasoning_details_replay` + `structured_reasoning_details`. Plain-text `reasoning` replay is coherent on its own; signed-block replay is a separate change and deliberately out of scope here.
- **`include_extra_body` flipping `False → True` is a behaviour change** for any caller already sending `extra_body` to Command Code: it now reaches the gateway instead of being silently dropped, and a caller sending a canonical field now gets a loud `InvalidRequestError` instead of silence. That is the intended contract everywhere else in the fleet.
- **`minimax/minimax-m3-free` will still show 0% thinking.** CONFIRMED as a model property; no dialect changes it. Reasoning on that family needs `MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3`.
- The probe covers two models directly and the gateway's shared validator for the rest. Per-model reasoning support beyond those two is SUSPECTED from the gateway-wide enum, not individually measured.

## Deliberately not done (separately queued)

`providers/nvidia_nim/retry.py` stripping `chat_template_kwargs` on 400s; the `_apply_context_headroom` floor; credential health benching on a 400.

commit.message:
feat(commandcode): send the gateway's reasoning_effort and read the reasoning it returns

Command Code has never asked for reasoning and could not have surfaced any
if it arrived. Its profile carried NO_REASONING, so the outbound body was
literally {"model": ..., "max_tokens": ...} on every request, and its
reasoning_delta_field defaulted to "reasoning_content" while the gateway
emits "reasoning". Two live databases show ~23,000 Command Code requests
across all seven of its models with zero thinking blocks, ever, against
74-76% for nous_portal and nvidia_nim over the same window. The provider
was added in #78 and nothing under providers/commandcode/ has changed since.

Command Code's /v1/models cannot settle the dialect: every row carries a
null `reasoning`, `supported_parameters` and `default_parameters`. The
dialect was therefore probed live against api.commandcode.ai rather than
guessed, and the profile branches on nothing but the gateway's own
documented behaviour.

Probe evidence (streaming /chat/completions, reasoning chars in delta):

  z-ai/glm-5.3-flash
    bare                          200  reasoning=180..3342  reasoning_details present
    reasoning:{effort:high}       200  reasoning=489        (object ignored)
    reasoning:{effort:BOGUS}      200  reasoning=489        (object ignored -- not parsed)
    thinking:{type:disabled}      200  reasoning=421        (object ignored)
    chat_template_kwargs          200  reasoning=561        (ignored)
    reasoning_effort=none         400  Invalid option: expected one of "low"|"medium"|"high"|"xhigh"|"max"
    reasoning_effort=minimal      400  same
    reasoning_effort=BOGUS        400  same

  MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3   bare -> reasoning=0, 0
                         reasoning_effort=max -> reasoning=8032, 2263

`reasoning_effort` is the only reasoning parameter the gateway parses: an
invalid value 400s with the enum named in the message, while a deliberately
invalid `reasoning` object returns 200 untouched. MiniMax-M3 proves the
parameter is honoured, not merely validated -- it emits no reasoning at all
by default and 2-8 KB of it under effort=max. Effort is monotone on
glm-5.3-flash across repeats (low=0/0/0, medium=1.2-2.3k, xhigh/max=1.6-4.5k).

This wires NamedEffortReasoning over that enum:

- Efforts map onto low|medium|high|xhigh|max; FCC's MINIMAL, which the
  gateway rejects, folds onto "low". Nothing branches on a model name.
- No disabled value. The enum has no "none"/"off" rung and both 400, so
  reasoning OFF sends no reasoning field -- the dialect's only correct
  disabled shape.
- No enabled value. A bare request already reasons the most the gateway
  offers, so naming a rung for "on, effort unspecified" would reduce
  reasoning rather than request it.
- reasoning_delta_field="reasoning" (fallback "reasoning_content"), because
  the gateway streams `reasoning` deltas. Reading the default field is why
  reasoning that did arrive was discarded before reaching the client.
- reasoning_replay REASONING, not THINK_TAGS: no probe response ever put a
  <think> tag in content, so assistant history was being re-encoded in a
  shape this gateway never produces.
- include_extra_body=True with the canonical-field validator, matching
  openrouter_gateway and zenmux. Caller extras reach the gateway; they
  cannot forge reasoning_effort.

Command Code's Anthropic-protocol half (claude-* models) needs no change:
it goes through build_anthropic_messages_body, whose _apply_reasoning
already emits the native `thinking` object.

Verification: `.\scripts\ci.ps1` -- suppression grep, ruff format, ruff
check, ty check all clean. pytest: 14 failed, 5661 passed, 38 skipped --
exactly the pre-existing baseline (6 PowerShell installer, 8 websearch
reading the real ~/.fcc/.env), none in the touched files. Ten new tests
pin the effort enum, the OFF shape, a ladder-clamped effort, extra_body
passthrough and forgery rejection, the delta field and replay shape, and a
regression guard that bedrock/cline still send nothing while ollama and
zenmux keep their own distinct dialects.

Deliberately not done: structured reasoning_details replay (the gateway
emits reasoning_details, but plain-text `reasoning` replay is coherent on
its own and signed-block replay is a separate change); nvidia_nim's retry
stripping chat_template_kwargs on 400s; the _apply_context_headroom floor;
credential health benching on a 400.
